content:
Apple is about to launch a brand-new iPad mini, which will be the first update to the device in two years, and is expected to be a major upgrade. Here's everything we know so far about the new iPad mini debuting next month.

OLED Display

The most significant change to the new iPad mini will be the display. According to multiple sources, the iPad mini 8 will feature an OLED display.

This will be a major upgrade over the LCD screen on the current iPad mini. For users, switching to OLED means deeper blacks, richer colours, and better contrast. The iPhone X became the first iPhone with an OLED display in 2017, while the OLED-equipped iPad Pro arrived in 2024.

However, one unresolved question is whether the new iPad mini will adopt a ProMotion display to support refresh rates of up to 120Hz. According to an unconfirmed report last Monday, the new iPad mini will not offer ProMotion support, with the refresh rate capped at 60Hz.

That said, this rumour has not been confirmed by other sources, so I'm still hoping it's wrong.

New Chip

The current iPad mini, launched in October 2024, uses Apple's A17 Pro chip. The new iPad mini is expected to feature an A19 Pro or A20 Pro chip, which would bring significant performance gains and potentially support the most advanced Siri AI features in iOS 27.

Better Water Resistance

According to Bloomberg, Apple has tested a "redesigned enclosure" for the iPad mini that offers iPhone-like water resistance.

Whether this water-resistant enclosure actually makes it to production remains to be seen. It would, however, make the iPad mini more durable — which is especially important for those who use it as an e-reader, since water resistance is one of the key selling points of dedicated e-readers like the Kindle.

New Audio Technology

The iPad mini 8 could also become the first Apple device to feature an improved version of a vibration-based audio system. This type of system could allow Apple to remove the speaker grilles, helping achieve the device's water-resistant design.

By comparison, while the iPhone has speaker grilles, Apple achieves water resistance through the use of waterproof seals and adhesives.

New iPad mini Release Date

According to the latest Bloomberg report, Apple is targeting an October launch this year at the earliest for the OLED-equipped iPad mini. It's said to be the "biggest overhaul to the iPad mini in five and a half years."

As for the pricing of the new iPad mini, there's no word yet. Apple raised the price of the current iPad mini from $499 to $599 in July this year (currently on sale at Amazon for $569). Whether the OLED-equipped new iPad mini will cost even more remains to be seen.

What do you think of the rumoured plans for Apple's iPad mini? Does the OLED display excite you? Let us know in the comments section.
